findings.evidence: grep -rhoE '^private (noncomputable |protected )*(def|theorem|lemma|abbrev|structure|inductive|instance|class)' TauCeti → 1913 private theorem, 1078 private lemma, 233+239 private def, 31+6 private abbrev, 21+2 private instance, 2 private structure; 111 of those theorems/lemmas are preceded by an `@[simp` line (e.g. TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/FaithfullyFlatDescent.lean:114).
findings.fix: Filter only private declarations that are auto-generated (e.g. keep `d` unless `isPrivateName d && (← getEnv).isAutoDecl d`, or match on the parent-declaration shape of equation lemmas), and grandfather whatever hand-written private declarations still fail into scripts/lint-baseline.txt so the exemptions stay visible and reviewable.
findings.issue: `(← getDeclsInPackage `TauCeti).filter (!Lean.isPrivateName ·)` drops every private declaration, not just the private equation lemmas the PR diagnoses. TauCeti has ~3,500 hand-written `private` declarations (1913 `private theorem`, 1078 `private lemma`, 472 defs/abbrevs, 23 instances, 2 structures), including 111 carrying `@[simp]` — a private `@[simp]` lemma is still globally active, so simpNF stops judging it. It also makes `private` an untracked bypass of the `@[nolint]` allowlist this script builds to prevent exactly that.

findings.evidence: scripts/lint-env.sh:583-589 prints unmatched baseline entries as a ratchet reminder every run; the PR body confirms this entry stops being produced.

findings.issue: `structureInType TauCeti.BCRPoint✝` can never be produced again once private declarations are filtered, so it becomes a permanent RATCHET reminder on every run; the header's LINTER FAILED example at scripts/lint-env.sh:102-103 ("structureInType currently crashes on a private structure") likewise becomes unreachable.

summary: The blanket `!isPrivateName` filter is broader than the module-system artifact it is meant to work around, and removes lint coverage that exists under the current pins — the header's justification that private names were already skipped is contradicted by the repo's own baseline. Narrow the filter to private auto-generated names and correct the stale header claims.
